summary: Re-test of the 3 fixes from iteration 2 plus regression sweep. Backend: re-ran /app/backend/tests/ (backend_test.py + test_enhancements.py) -> 35/36 passed; only the known TestAuth::test_brute_force_lockout fails (no rate limiting implemented, 6x401). Frontend (Playwright, public preview URL, admin login): FIX1 Tab focus VERIFIED — add-task -> type 'kid' -> Tab (activeElement stays INPUT[line-input], value 'kid') -> type 'MORE' gives 'kidMORE'; Shift+Tab also keeps focus ('kidMOREX'); after re-indent + reload content persisted as '[ ] parent task\n  [ ] kidMOREX'. FIX2 indent creep VERIFIED — seeded '[ ] Buy groceries / 2sp - milk and eggs / 2sp [ ] check pantry', archived + restored TWICE: restored content byte-identical to the original both cycles (no 4-space growth), and persisted across reload. FIX3 mobile drag handle VERIFIED — at 390x844 [data-testid=drag-handle] is visible, opacity 1, box x=20 w=20 (on-screen, not clipped). Regressions all pass: cascade DOWN ([x] parent -> both children [x]), uncheck parent leaves children checked, cascade UP (parent auto-checks when last child re-checked), persisted after reload; add-section-btn -> '# Evening'; real mouse drag reorder (T3 dragged above T1 -> 'T3,T1,T2'); real mouse drag onto backlog-panel (T3 removed from day, appears in backlog with 'Moved to backlog' toast); settings dialog interval-custom + interval-days-input=5 + weekday-6 deselect all PUT /api/settings and reload with saved values. Frequency options now render radio indicators (a11y note from iteration 2 visually addressed).

minor.issue: Still no brute-force lockout: 6 consecutive wrong passwords return 401 each, never 429 (known/expected, pre-existing).

issues: Frequency options still plain <button> without role=radio/aria-checked (visual radio dot only) — minor a11y/testability gap.
Row actions (archive) and drag handle remain hover-only on >=640px; acceptable, mobile now always visible.

action_items: Optional/pre-existing: add login rate limiting (429 after 5 failures) — only remaining failing backend test.
Optional: role=radio/aria-checked on settings frequency options; debounce saveSettings (one PUT per click observed).
critical_code_review_comments: setIndent now sets focusTarget with caret — fix is correct, but SortableBlock keys remain positional (`${date}#${pos}`); any future op changing grouping still risks remount/focus loss. Consider stable block ids.
GET /api/board still unpaginated (to_list(1000)) and run_rollover rewrites every past day per fire — scalability risk.
saveSettings/saveBacklog still issue one API call per interaction (3 PUT /api/settings per short session) — debounce like day content.
seed_data_creation: Used admin account only; today's board content and backlog were cleared at the end; settings restored to rollover_enabled=true, interval daily, all 7 weekdays. pytest fixtures auto-clean their throwaway users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Env today = 2026-08-20. All three iteration-2 bugs (Tab focus, indent creep, mobile drag handle) are confirmed fixed. Regression suites: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q (expect 1 known failure: test_brute_force_lockout). Real mouse drags work: grab [data-testid=drag-handle], mouse.down, ~20 small moves, mouse.up. Seed content fast via [data-testid=view-plain-btn] + [data-testid=plain-editor].
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — previously reported RCAs (focusTarget missing in setIndent; double +1 indent in moveBacklogToToday; 'hidden sm:flex' on drag handle) all addressed and verified end-to-end.
